entries.name: ComedySportz San Jose (CSz San Jose)
entries.summary: Long-running improv comedy theatre with its own venue in San Jose, presenting family-friendly competitive improv shows every Friday and Saturday plus a class program, summer camps, and a high school league.
entries.schedule: Shows every Friday and Saturday; ongoing adult classes, Camp ComedySportz summer camps, and a high school league
signals: Own dedicated theatre venue at 5440 Thornwood Dr, San Jose
Part of the international ComedySportz league/format; site references operating since 1987
Education arm covers adult classes, summer camps, and a high school league
entries.reasons: Strong permanent-home and show-cadence score from an established, branded venue with weekly shows, with points held back only because the homepage doesn't surface explicit class levels or a dated October calendar.
